purpose: Define a standalone TableReadingTable component (React) that renders an AFOQT-style data table, binds to tableSpec + a question, and does not break the host application's CSS/UX.
integrationRule: DO NOT import the full Table Reading preview page. Import ONLY the table component + its scoped styles.

constraints: each row in cellValues must have length equal to xHeader.length

notes: Prefer explicit lookup.x and lookup.y instead of parsing text.
If lookup is missing, component should render without highlight.

componentAPI.name: TableReadingTable
behavior: If rowIndex or colIndex is -1, render table normally (no highlight).
If mode === 'test', never show debug info such as computed cell value.
If enableCueAnimation is true, run a short cue: pulse row header -> pulse column header -> pulse cell (Web Animations API).

cssIsolationPlan.requirement: Component styles must not alter :root, body, html, generic tags, or shared button/table styles in the host app.

approvedApproaches.details: Use TableReadingTable.module.css and import styles as 'styles'. All class names become locally scoped.
If you must use global CSS, every selector must be prefixed with .trtScope and the component root must render <div className='trtScope'>.

hardBlocks: No body background or font overrides

visualDesignTokens.theme: inherits host app, but can accept optional CSS variables for styling

legend: optional div legend for X and Y meaning
legend uses small text; no effect on global typography

table.thead: top header row: corner label + X headers
table.tbody: each row: Y header + value cells
sticky: first column th is sticky left
table.targetCell: apply target background class when rowIndex/colIndex matches

questionToTableMapping.recommended: Store lookup coordinates explicitly on each question: question.lookup.x and question.lookup.y
questionToTableMapping.fallback: If your legacy dataset only has text, parse with regex for 'X = n' and 'Y = n', but migrate to explicit lookup ASAP.
validation: If lookup.x not in xHeader OR lookup.y not in yHeader, treat as non-highlight question (no crash).

acceptanceTests: Does not change host app background, fonts, or button styles.
Renders correctly inside any container width (scrolls horizontally if too narrow).
Sticky header and sticky Y column work while scrolling.
Highlights correct cell when lookup matches headers.
No highlight and no crash when lookup is null or not found.
